name: Texto SMS API
description:
REST API for the Texto SMS platform. Send single or bulk SMS to Australian
mobiles, receive replies, manage opt-outs, and get real-time delivery
receipts via signed webhooks. Data is hosted in Australia.

Full human-readable docs: https://texto.com.au/api
Webhook reference: https://texto.com.au/webhooks
